canada.title: ‘2 years ahead of schedule’: Chief speaks about new police service as it replaces RCMP in Grande Prairie
canada.summary: The Grande Prairie Police Service has formally taken over for the RCMP in the northern Alberta city following a transition between services that took place more quickly than originally planned.

canada.title: Hamilton, Halton police halt use of Crime Stoppers over leak of tips
canada.summary: After a CBC investigation found more than 1.5 million Canadian Crime Stoppers tips were leaked in a data breach in June, police forces around Ontario — including in Hamilton and Halton Region — are pausing the use of Crime Stoppers.

canada.title: Frustration on menu as construction drags on
canada.summary: Nearly four months of construction outside the front door of a longtime Portage Avenue restaurant has driven away customers and left its owner struggling to cover operating expenses.

canada.title: Accused Tumbler Ridge co-conspirator enters not guilty plea in U.S. court
canada.summary: James Cody Bryant entered a not guilty plea in a Seattle courtroom Thursday, for the charge of conspiracy to murder persons in a foreign country.

canada.title: After 72 years, Atikamekw baby will be reburied in home community of Manawan
canada.summary: More than 70 years after leaving his home in the northern Quebec community of Manawan, an Atikamekw baby's body was found in Quebec City following the exhumation of a common grave.

canada.title: B.C. jury finds Adam Mann guilty in 2024 home-invasion murder of Tori Dunn
canada.summary: The man accused of killing Surrey, B.C., resident Tori Dunn during a home invasion two years ago has been convicted of second-degree murder.

canada.title: ‘Part of the city’s DNA’: Former BioWare writer reflects on company's impact on Edmonton
canada.summary: Videogame developer BioWare announced Wednesday it will be closing its doors after operating in Edmonton for more than 30 years. BioWare produced numerous popular game franchises such as Mass Effect and Baldur's Gate.

canada.title: Quebec Superior Court hears arguments to suspend Montreal bylaw banning insults to police
canada.summary: Lawyers told Quebec Superior Court on Thursday that it should suspend a recently adopted bylaw banning insults against employees of the City of Montreal, including police officers.

canada.title: Potential school support worker strike in N.S. puts families in limbo
canada.summary: For Kirkley Westhaver, a strike would mean having to decide whether she tags along with her eight-year-old daughter to school or has her daughter stay home.

canada.title: N.S. premier says the time will come for written agreements for data centre
canada.summary: At some point an agreement in writing will be required between the Nova Scotia government and the company that wants to build a data centre here, but Premier Tim Houston says that point has yet to arrive.

canada.summary: Newspaper of record for Nunavut, and the Nunavik territory of Quebec

canada.title: Haines Junction residents frustrated as post office closures continue
canada.summary: Repeated closures at the Haines Junction post office are frustrating residents who say Canada Post should better communicate their hours and do more to retain staff. Canada Post says it's trying to fill a vacant postmaster position, but can't provide regular opening hours as staffing shortages continue.

canada.title: NDP rejects claim from Scott Moe that it used AI to create health-care plan
canada.summary: In a social media post Wednesday, Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe accused the Opposition of using AI to write its health care plan. NDP leader Carla Beck disputed his claims.

canada.title: Man charged with 1st-degree murder in Regina shooting earlier this month
canada.summary: A man is charged with first-degree murder in a fatal shooting in Regina earlier this month.

canada.title: N.L. spent $32.1 million in 2.5 years on private virtual health-care services
canada.summary: A mayor in rural Newfoundland says most people in his community who needed urgent care in the past few years arrived at the local health centre and "talked to a TV."

canada.title: 3 arrested after string of online marketplace robberies, $80K in Pokemon cards among targets: Toronto police
canada.summary: Three people have been arrested after an investigation into a string of violent robberies linked to online marketplace transactions, including the theft of an $80,000 Pokémon card collection, Toronto police say.

canada.title: May preliminary inquiry for man accused of Moncton murder
canada.summary: A preliminary inquiry has been scheduled for next spring for a man accused of a murder in Moncton.

canada.title: Fall storm could bring 15-25 cm of snow to northern Manitoba
canada.summary: A "significant fall storm" is headed to northern Manitoba, bringing rain that will transition into heavy, wet snow with as much as 15 to 25 centimetres expected, says Environment Canada.
